title: AI Scientist v2 — Automating the Research Loop
titleKn: AI Scientist v2 — ಸಂಶೋಧನಾ Loop ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲನೆ
desc: AI Scientist systems generate ideas, run experiments, analyse results and write papers with minimal human input.
objectives: Describe the stages of an automated research pipeline.
Explain the role of tree search over experiments.
objectivesKn: ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ tree search ಪಾತ್ರ ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

title: AI Scientist v2 — What the Results Show
titleKn: AI Scientist v2 — ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಏನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ
desc: Automatically generated papers have reached workshop-level review, but with real quality limits.

title: AI Scientist v2 — Responsible Use
desc: Automated research raises questions about disclosure, review load and the safety of running generated code.
objectives: Explain why AI authorship must be disclosed.
Recognise the review burden and code-safety issues.
objectivesKn: ವಿಮರ್ಶೆ ಹೊರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೋಡ್ ಸುರಕ್ಷತೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.
